control_definitions.matrix: Three metals x syn/anti x zero/one water; try at least two water directions and classify bound/lost water explicitly. If a bound state repeatedly collapses, retain that scientific result with structures and account for separated water in the reaction.
control_definitions.fixed_backbone: At each dry La syn/anti geometry replace only the metal and compute Tb/Lu single points; compare frozen and relaxed within-metal gaps. Never compare raw different-metal energies.
control_definitions.water_cycle: Close each syn/anti water-addition square: hydration effect on conformer gap equals difference of hydration free energies.
control_definitions.thermochemistry: Source gas geometry/frequencies plus solution single points; use the same qRRHO cutoff/standard states and repeat a reasonable low-frequency treatment sensitivity.

observable_definition: For each metal and identical hydration n, delta_G=G(anti,n)-G(syn,n) at 298 K, 1 M complexes in aqueous SMD. G=E_solv+(G_gas-E_gas) with consistent source low-frequency treatment, no double-counted ZPE. Water-addition delta_G=G(LnL.H2O)-G(LnL)-G(H2O) with 55.5 M water standard state. Frozen metal replacements compare electronic within-metal conformer gaps, not equilibrium G.

required_comparisons.description: Frozen metal replacement and closed hydration squares
Molecular ECP identity and low-frequency robustness

optional_not_scored: Quantitative extraction/metal selectivity is outside scope without an independently closed metal hydration-exchange cycle; no full exchange cycle is mandatory here.
source_note: Molecular identities, benchmark-defined starts and explicitly labelled measured observations are authorized inputs. Graph provenance identifies chemical identity only; state labels, optimized added geometries and predicted outputs are withheld. See task.md for the common scientific scope.
public_private_boundary: Identity/connectivity and declared measured observations are public. Author optimized new candidate geometries, computed rankings, reference outputs and legacy PASS archives are private.
